column1: # Defensome Pfam map. One row per gene family.
# pfam_ids : comma-separated Pfam accessions (no version suffix)
# rule     : ANY = protein needs >=1 of the listed domains
#            ALL = protein needs every listed domain (architecture requirement)
# min_cov  : minimum fraction of the HMM aligned (summed over non-overlapping hits)
# min_len  : minimum protein length in aa
# tier     : CORE = well-defined, safe to compare across species
#            BROAD = huge superfamily, counts are inflated, interpret with care
# rescue   : yes = also search below Pfam's gathering threshold, for families
#            whose members can score too low to pass it (very short domains,
#            divergent taxa). Rescued calls are reported separately and never
# validate : extra checks a RESCUED protein must pass, ';'-separated:
#            non-overlapping hits of the family HMM on the protein)
